question: Happy Birthday, Otto! A question: How many letters does Otto write? I have the mental image of his Interior Minister job meaning that he has to communicate with a lot of people, but he probably doesn't write about private things that would make people worry, so I felt like maybe the things he could actually talk about were unexpectedly scarce.
answer: I think he writes a fairly good amount of letters. He has a lot of document jobs, too, so he's holding a quill pen a lot, but he doesn't want his family to worry either, so perhaps he doesn't write to his family often. On top of that, it would be troublesome if his location was discovered by the hitman in his home town looking to kill him.
